description: Railway Network WFS is a dataset listed in Geonorge, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bane NOR SF. WFS service for the dataset Railway Network consist of geographic reference lines for railway lines that form part of the Norwegian national railway infrastructure. The dataset uses linear referencing according to Bane NOR's model using kilometer chainage. Coverage: Bane NOR SF. The publisher named on the listing is Bane NOR SF. Its keywords include Kilometrering, Railway, Jernbanestasjon, Jernbane, Chainage, Banenettverk. The listing shows 2018-10-31 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://data.norge.no/nlod/no/1.0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geonorge.
